questions.question: What is the monthly fee of my Aurora account?

criteria.factHint: states EUR 6 as the Aurora monthly fee

runs.answer:
Your Aurora account’s monthly fee for September 2026 is **EUR 0**. Both waiver conditions were met: salary of EUR 1,750 (minimum EUR 1,200) and four card-like purchases (minimum three) [aurora-fees-2026 v2].

Caveats: The ledger does not record settlement status, so posted card purchases were treated as settled. Movements were assessed by their posting date in September; postings near a month boundary may fall in an adjacent month.
